samples.summary: rest-api.md — the canonical doc for the `/api/v1` surface — is not updated for the ~15 routes this change adds
samples.evidence: The change adds `DELETE .../tabs/:tid`, `POST .../tabs/:tid/reorder`, `POST .../tabs/:tid/duplicate`, `GET|PUT .../tabs/:tid/images`, `GET .../documents/:did/layouts`, `POST|DELETE .../documents/:did/slides[...]`, the whole `.../comments` tree, and board dispatch on `.../content`. rest-api.md §5.2 still lists only `GET/POST tabs` + `PATCH tabs/:tid`; §5.4 still documents `POST .../tabs/:tid/move` as the axis move with no mention that a tab reorder now had to take a different verb because of that collision; §5.5 still says the content routes serve `doc`/`slides`/`note`; §6 Module Structure omits every new controller. CONTRIBUTING requires the canonical subsystem doc to record architecture/API changes, and the notification and sheets-comments docs were updated in this same diff — so the omission is selective rather than a blanket "no docs" choice. The top-level backtick-path CI check does not catch a doc that is merely stale.
searchedFor: grep for api/v1 in sheets/charts.md and sheets/sheet-image.md

samples.summary: cli.md's command tree and safety-annotation table are not updated for the new CLI namespaces
samples.evidence: cli.md §4 maintains the full command tree (down to `sheets charts`, `docs set-content`, `images`, `folders`) and §8.4 a per-command safety table (`sheets.charts.set` → destructive, etc.). This change adds `comments` (7 verbs), `board content`/`board set-content`, `sheets images get|set`, `slides layouts` + `slides slide add|duplicate|move|delete`, and `sheets tabs delete|move|duplicate`, plus matching `schema/registry.ts` entries — none of which appear in cli.md. The agent-facing surface doc and the shipped `schema` registry now disagree about what the CLI offers.

samples.summary: The capability audit's class-B table gets no status note, breaking the pattern the same doc established for classes A and A′
samples.evidence: §3 records "Status note (Step 3 …)" under class A and "Status note (Step 4 …)" under class A′ when those gaps closed, explicitly keeping the tables as measured. This change closes all 18 class-B items (comments 6, slide granular 5, tab rearrange 3, sheet floating images 2, board 2) and adds no equivalent note, so §3 still reads "No command can close these" and "`docs-content.controller.ts:94` rejects any type that is not doc/slides/note" — which the diff has just made false. This is the originating audit doc; leaving it stale defeats its stated role as the roadmap re-derived per tag.

samples.summary: The mention grammar moved to `@wafflebase/sheets` but comments-mentions.md still names the frontend module as its home
samples.evidence: docs/design/comments-mentions.md:87 heads the section "New shared helper — `packages/frontend/src/components/comments/mentions.ts`" and lines 102–127 specify `serializeMention` / `parseMentionBody` / `extractMentionedUserIds` as living there. After this change that file is a re-export shell and the canonical implementation is `packages/sheets/src/comment/mentions.ts`. Only notifications.md records the move; the doc that owns the mention design does not, so a reader of the canonical mentions doc is pointed at the wrong layer.

samples.summary: Board document shape is now declared a third time; the existing backend `BoardRoot` and its docblock are left contradicting the new module
samples.evidence: `packages/backend/src/template/seed/board.ts:13` already declares `BoardRoot { meta: { title }, elements: SlidesElement[] }` and its docblock states "There is no backend writer for boards the way there is for docs / slides / notes — `PUT /documents/:id/content` covers only those three" — which this change makes false. `@wafflebase/board` also exports `BoardModel` with exactly the `{ meta: { title, unit?, recentColors? }, elements }` shape the new `BoardDocument` restates (packages/board/src/model/board.ts:22). The backend does not depend on `@wafflebase/board`, so importing it would need a dependency, but the two in-backend declarations (`BoardRoot` and `BoardYorkieRoot`) could have been one and are now free to drift.

samples.summary: The pivot-dependency scan is re-implemented rather than shared with the editor's two existing copies
samples.evidence: `resolveDelete` walks `root.tabOrder` matching `sheets[id].pivotTable.sourceTabId === tabId`. The identical loop already exists twice in `packages/frontend/src/app/documents/document-detail.tsx` (lines 511-518 and 551-558). This repo's stated pattern for tab work is to share the rule through `@wafflebase/sheets` (create/rename reuse `generateTabId` / `getUniqueTabName` / `normalizeTabName`, per rest-api.md §5.2); the dependency rule was left as a third hand-written copy, so a change to how a pivot records its source has three sites to find. (The deliberate behavioral difference — API refuses, editor cascades after a confirm — is fine and documented; the duplicated scan is the point.)
searchedFor: grep pivotTable/sourceTabId in frontend and backend

samples.summary: `PATCH .../comments/:threadId/comments/:commentId` (edit a comment) has no CLI command and no schema entry, recreating a class-A gap for a route this change just added
samples.evidence: The controller exposes `editComment` and the design doc update to sheets/comments.md advertises API-side author-only *edit* enforcement, but `packages/cli/src/commands/comments.ts` registers only list/add/reply/resolve/unresolve/delete/delete-comment, `http-client.ts` has no `editComment`, and `schema/registry.ts` has no `comments.edit`. The stated purpose of this work is agent reachability from a terminal; an endpoint with no command is precisely the class-A shape the audit says costs a CLI command to close.

samples.summary: `duplicateTab` invents semantics the editor has no counterpart for, unlike every other verb in this change
samples.evidence: The audit's framing for these gaps is that the editor already exercises the behavior and only a callable path is missing; slides add/duplicate/move/delete honour that by running `MemSlidesStore`, the engine store the editor mirrors. There is no tab-duplicate anywhere in the frontend (grep for Duplicate under app/spreadsheet finds only chart-registry), so the copy's rules — name `"<tab> (copy)"` uniqued, comments dropped, metadata fields carried selectively — are decided by the API alone with no editor behaviour to match and no design doc recording them. If the editor later grows a duplicate-tab command the two will be free to disagree.

samples.summary: Version markers for the same change disagree across the two updated docs
samples.evidence: notifications.md says "Since v0.6.7 that premise has one exception" for the new comments controller, while sheets/comments.md says "since v0.6.8 it is no longer the only writer" about the same controller; `packages/cli/package.json` is already at 0.6.8, so the released-in version is at best 0.6.8 and neither marker can be 0.6.7.
